questions: What does 'tolerance' mean, as explained in the lesson?
Bearing pain or hardships with patience
Tolerance means to bear pain or hardships with patience, and to bear things you do not like.
At the conquest of Makkah, how did the Holy Prophet (PBUH) treat Abu Sufyan?
He forgave Abu Sufyan and declared amnesty for those who took refuge in his house.
Who did Allah send to the Holy Prophet (PBUH) after the people of Taif stoned him?
Allah sent the Angel of the Mountains, who offered to crush the people between two mountains.
What did the Holy Prophet (PBUH) reply to the Angel of the Mountains?
No; I hope their children will worship Allah alone
He said no, hoping that Allah would let them beget children who worship Allah alone.
For how many years did Hazrat Anas bin Malik serve the Holy Prophet (PBUH)?
Hazrat Anas said, 'I served the Rasoolullah for 10 years.'

The first visitor was a hunter looking for shelter.

The second knock was a farmer asking for shelter.

Who told the old man not to open the door again?
The farmer objected; afterwards he felt guilty and apologised for being selfish.

Who was the second Caliph of Islam?
Hazrat Umar (RA) was the second Caliph of Islam.
Hazrat Umar (RA) belonged to which tribe?
He was born at Makkah Mukarramah into a noble tribe of the Quraish.

Which reform did Hazrat Umar (RA) introduce to investigate complaints against state offices?
He introduced administrative courts to investigate complaints against the offices of the state.
How did Hazrat Umar (RA) treat the worship places of non-Muslims?
The worship places and property of non-Muslims were given protection.
What does the proverb 'mens sana in corpore sano' mean?

Haji Usman was a wise old man respected for his piety, who often settled quarrels.
He lived in a little village near Faisalabad.
Who were the two men quarrelling?
The two men were Haroon and Salman, his neighbours.
What was the cause of their quarrel?
Salman's tractor destroyed some of Haroon's crops
Salman had accidentally destroyed some of Haroon's crops by driving his tractor through his fields.

Who first conquered Mount Everest in 1953?

Why do climbers need artificial oxygen at great heights?
